13.
Any person who makes any false allegation in any
information  disclosed  by  such  person  under  section  16  of
this Act, knowing the content of such allegation to be false
or having reasons to believe that such allegation is not true,
commits an offence under this Act and shall, on conviction
by a Magistrate, be liable to a fine not exceeding rupees one
hundred  thousand  or  to  imprisonment  for  a  period  not
exceeding three years or to both such fine and imprisonment.
